summary: Owned boot-relative outbox clock, writer-linearized sampling, cumulative drift anchor, schema-v5 exact migration, and assurance-graph cleanup.
authority_corrections: production outbox APIs no longer accept caller-supplied epoch time

missing or stale receipts fail before clock sampling
cumulative drift is bounded from a durable initialization/recovery anchor
Linux clock identity binds the calling thread time namespace
complete clock state and policy are canonicalized and persisted in schema v5
v1-v4 migration preserves known history and quarantines legacy unbound time
exact v4 retry provenance has positive preservation and tamper-rejection fixtures
retired time-fence build, test, audit, and release-verifier assumptions are removed
